notes.title: Post Steam Sale Update
notes.notes:
Now that the Steam sale has wrapped up I thought it would be a good time to make a quick post addressing everything that happened.

Firstly there has been a whole bunch of changes fixing various bugs and adding an option to turn off VSync in game. A big thank you to everyone who got in contact and let me know about any bugs they found.

Also a huge thank you to everyone who left a review on the store page, I know the lack of reviews was putting some people off from trying the game so I really appreciate you taking the time to write them.

On the topic of reviews it seems that the game has been pretty well received except for the price. I noticed a few of you felt it was too short for $20 and so taking this feedback I decided to permanently drop the price by 25%.

Ok that's all for now, I hope everyone who picked the game up during the sale enjoys it.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
I have uploaded another patch with some small quality of life tweaks and minor bug fixes.

One reported bug that I couldn't replicate when testing involved Brady teleporting backwards during the escape sequence on day 7 (thanks to Teddi for reporting it). I made the conditions that control his state changes less strict and repositioned him slightly in hopes that it fixes the issue. If anyone else experiences this bug or can find a way to replicate it let me know.

I also wrapped up the behind the scenes series last month. I'm not sure how but what was supposed to be a series of 10 minute videos turned into 45 minute podcasts rambling about games in general.

The episodes are as follows:
0: Introduction and why I made the game (Lots of rambling feel free to skip this one)
1: Building an early prototype and showing footage of some very early tests
2: Making art assets and showing off early concept art
3: Talking about content that was removed or changed and why
4: Bug fixing and adding the music
5: Getting the game on steam and my final thoughts
Here is a playlist if you are interested in checking it out: Watch
